metadata.authorship: Original SolidCraft prepared-demo authoring specifications. The separately pinned native source is documented in source-lock.json; these semantic resources remain unbound.
metadata.source_requirement: Require ../source-lock.json active_source.status='pinned_native', matching accepted bytes/format/units/+Z, confirmed admission review and reviewed semantic selectors. An expected filename is not proof of identity.

coordinate_frame.horizontal_axes_basis: Authored presentation-stage convention; not an observed native vehicle heading.
coordinate_frame.source_alignment_policy: Review and record the improved source-to-stage instance alignment before use; do not rewrite native component transforms.

metadata.numeric_policy: Values are authored initial settings or inherited catalog parameters. No value is a measured model transform, source photometry, optical constant or mechanical property.
metadata.native_target_policy: No legacy source IDs are targets. Resolve semantic roles against the accepted native file and save the source hash with the reviewed selectors.
metadata.runtime_policy: This JSON is an authoring specification. It is not an engine command and does not claim resource loading, rendering, simulation or application integration.
metadata.reference_scene_policy: Existing SCENE IDs remain unchanged. A reference_scene_id records design lineage; effective composition comes from the explicit fields in each shot.
metadata.native_opaque_compiler_policy: prepare.py compile is restricted to reviewed native BODY selections for roles with kind=appearance, owner=subject and opaque_proxy_allowed=true. Stage geometry, framing, interaction regions, layered dust, optics and emitters are not compiled by that tool.
